row_policy: No rows dropped; frozen snapshot already excludes non-injury crashes.

categorical_policy.whitespace: reject surrounding whitespace rather than silently normalize
categorical_policy.training_vocabulary: fit on each training partition only
categorical_policy.unseen_category: map to __UNSEEN__ at model preprocessing time

numeric_policy.storage: numeric value or NaN; no imputation in the modeling table
numeric_policy.linear_and_ordered_models: training-only observed-value imputation plus an explicit missing indicator; no ordinary mean imputation for structurally sparse fields

test_boundary: 2025 schema, target counts and feature coverage were feasibility-audited, but no preprocessing fit or model performance is permitted before model/protocol freeze.
